segments.speaker: BOC Commissioner Ariel F. Nepomuceno
segments.text: But if I may, Your Honor, recognizing the complexity of the NSW project, what BOC has done when we came in July last year is to embark on our own, of course, with the support of the Secretary of Finance, Sec. Frederick, we are now embarking on our own customs processing system.

segments.speaker: BOC Commissioner Ariel F. Nepomuceno

segments.speaker: BOC Commissioner Ariel F. Nepomuceno
segments.text: CPS will remove the human intervention involved in the processes of the importations.

segments.speaker: BOC Commissioner Ariel F. Nepomuceno

segments.speaker: BOC Commissioner Ariel F. Nepomuceno

segments.speaker: BOC Commissioner Ariel F. Nepomuceno

segments.speaker: BOC Commissioner Ariel F. Nepomuceno
